notes: The hortative Let us is placed on the subjunctive ἐπισκεψώμεθα rather than on the participle it precedes in English; rule 17 forbids choosing a word merely because it stands first or finite, and rule 88 puts the juncture and on the verb it introduces.
and see is marked added under rule 103 with rule 5, the verb of visiting having spent its English on visit and no second verb standing in the Greek.
ἐν αἷς → wherein is one aligned unit under rule 35, the portmanteau spelling both elements.
